check_order_rationale: Validity FIRST, so a broken run can never read as a finding, and split equality before everything else because every other number is meaningless if the test sets differ.
criterion: ceiling: best achievable prediction of bacterial promoter activity from sequence, reported against the replicate-derived 0.941 ceiling

forecast.my_forecast_record_in_this_project: 3 of 7. The fragment-null P1 was falsified twice, P2 mislocated its interval, and the atlas arm's own bar put p=0.55 on LOSES_ALONE and p=0.08 on what actually happened. DO NOT defer to these priors.
forecast.rationale: Against: every sequence-statistics arm on this rung clusters 0.2691-0.3234 while the mean-pooled atlas sits at 0.5076, and a ridge over 1,280 or 2,560 correlated columns on ~33,000 training rows has far more variance to pay for than the 128-dim pool. Without a promoter register the bins are positions in an arbitrary window, which is the scoping correction above. For: mean-pooling provably discards information the latent carries, the incumbent's own recorded limit says so, and the ridge can ignore useless columns at alpha=1.0 more cheaply than it can recover discarded ones.

honest_limits_fixed_in_advance: No promoter anchor exists on this substrate, so a NO_GAIN says that position bins relative to an ARBITRARY window add nothing -- NOT that positional structure is absent. The negative must never be over-read as closing positional readouts generally.

The orientation convention of `seq` is UNRESOLVED and is inferred from a performance difference between two rungs. That is a 1-bit inference, not established biology: only 576 of 22,285 minus sequences (2.6%) have their reverse complement among the plus sequences, and ZERO of those share a peak, so plus and minus tiles are distinct genomic windows rather than two orientations of one element.

689 duplicate sequences are known on this substrate and are UNCHANGED by this arm. A train/test-straddling duplicate affects this arm exactly as it affects the incumbent, so the PAIRED comparison is the right shape while the absolute levels inherit the issue.
The encoder is FROZEN and its hyperparameters were chosen elsewhere; this is not a tuned positional model and a NO_GAIN does not bound what a fine-tuned one could do.
Ten seeds is the inherited pairing. The fragment-pyramid arm needed 270 pooled seeds before its null cleared, so ten may be too few here for the same reason.
The rung ceiling is 0.941 and replicate-derived. No tile-rung number may be read as a fraction of it without saying so.

comparator.why: the incumbent is never re-run by this arm, so this arm cannot move the number it is being graded against

margin.derivation: INHERITED verbatim from the tile-rung arms so the bars stay commensurable; the same margin the 499bp fragment arm, the hybrid/stack arms and the measured atlas arm were graded against.

scorer.protocol: StandardScaler on train, Ridge(alpha=1.0), fit on log1p(expression), score Spearman against RAW expression

split.leakage_unit: the called expression PEAK, not the tile
split.spec: genomewide.leave_peak_out(tiles, frac=0.25, seed=s) for s in 0..9

measured_and_inherited_from_the_probe.lag_set_rule: the LARGEST candidate whose design matrix fits in RAM under the headroom factor; declared before the numbers, and only ever gives up resolution to a resource limit rather than trading it for a nicer number
measured_and_inherited_from_the_probe.parity_tolerance_rule: the smallest power of ten at least 10x the achieved deviation; derived from the measurement, not preferred

multiplicity.autocorr_needs_no_orientation_variant: an autocorrelation is invariant under reversal of its series -- the set of position pairs separated by k is unchanged when the series is read backwards -- so the autocorr co-primary is IMMUNE to the unresolved orientation convention that the bins rungs carry a 1-bit inference about

co_primary_hypotheses.autocorr: does periodic SPACING carry signal, measured anchor-free so it does not need a promoter register
co_primary_hypotheses.bins10_mean_oriented: does a POSITION-RESOLVED reduction beat a position-AVERAGED one

multiplicity.divisor_discrepancy_recorded: The plan's prose named a '5-comparison corrected level' for the secondaries while listing FOUR of them. Neither 5 nor 4 is the family-wise count over everything measured, so this bar uses 6 = every rung on the ladder. That is strictly more conservative than the plan's 5, it is internally consistent, and it is outcome-neutral: a secondary can never be the arm's result, so its interval width moves no verdict. Recorded rather than silently applied.
multiplicity.why_ineligible: six rungs against one incumbent is a garden of forking paths if the best is reported; classify() consults the co-primaries ONLY, so ineligibility is enforced by construction rather than by convention

outcomes_defined_before_running.INDETERMINATE_NULL_FAIL: the shuffled-label control cleared the bar; nothing is graded
outcomes_defined_before_running.INDETERMINATE_PARITY_FAIL: the global mean derived from the stored bin means does not reproduce the committed embedding
outcomes_defined_before_running.INDETERMINATE_SPLIT_MISMATCH: the recomputed splits differ from the committed ones
outcomes_defined_before_running.POSITIONAL_ADDS: the corrected interval for at least one CO-PRIMARY's paired gain over the committed atlas per-seed values lies entirely above +0.02
outcomes_defined_before_running.POSITIONAL_AMBIGUOUS: at least one co-primary interval contains +0.02, so no difference is detectable at the corrected level
outcomes_defined_before_running.POSITIONAL_NO_GAIN: BOTH co-primary intervals lie entirely below +0.02

pre_commitments: The margin 0.02 is INHERITED and will NOT be re-specified after a number exists.
If the shuffled-label null fails, the response is MORE SEEDS, never a weaker control.
The measured sibling's 0.5076 is NEVER retro-edited; it is read from its committed per-seed table and this arm cannot move it.
A secondary rung is NEVER reported as the arm's result, however it scores. classify() cannot see the secondaries at all.
The verdict field emitted by the run is whatever this bar mechanically returns. A withdrawn reading goes in a namespace-separate block, leaving the verdict unedited.
A miss does NOT kill the fine-tuned variant or the four shipped expression heads. Each is a NEW arm to declare under R6, never a re-read of this one.
A rung whose design matrix fails the RAM pre-check is recorded as SKIPPED with its byte estimate, never silently dropped and never quietly retried at a smaller width.
question: Does a POSITION-RESOLVED reduction of the SAME frozen PromoterAtlas latent beat the position-AVERAGED mean-pool incumbent (median Spearman 0.5076) by the rung's inherited margin of 0.02?
scoping_corrections_fixed_in_advance: This arm CANNOT test the -35/-10 spacing claim its own ledger rationale asserts. genomewide.Tile exposes seq, expression, peak, strand, category, active, rep1, rep2 -- there is no TSS, no promoter register and no peak-relative offset, so a bin index is a position in an ARBITRARY 150 bp window, not a promoter coordinate. What is testable is narrower: does a position-resolved reduction beat a position-averaged one.

Because of that, the readout matching the stated spacing mechanism is NOT bins. Spacing is translation-invariant, so the anchor-free autocorrelation is a declared CO-PRIMARY testing a DIFFERENT hypothesis -- not a second shot at the same one.

parity.spec: derive the global mean from the STORED 10-bin means, score it through ridge_spearman on those same splits, and assert it reproduces the committed atlas per-seed values
parity.why: this is what makes every later number comparable to 0.5076 rather than merely adjacent to it

shuffled_label_null.derivation: same FORM and bar as the fragment-pyramid arm, whose own 10-seed null landed at +0.0517 and voided its verdict until a 270-seed pooled null cleared the gate
shuffled_label_null.on_failure: INDETERMINATE_NULL_FAIL, and SPEND MORE SEEDS -- never re-specify
shuffled_label_null.spec: refit the ridge on shuffled tile labels, same splits and seeds

split_equality.spec: recompute leave_peak_out(frac=0.25) for seeds 0-9 and assert n_test_per_seed matches the committed values for ALL ten
split_equality.why_first: every other number is meaningless if the test sets differ; the arm would not be scored on the incumbent's held-out peaks

why_this_is_not_a_re_read_of_the_measure: The incumbent arm reduces the latent with z[:, :, :L].mean(dim=2). This arm reduces the SAME forward pass differently and never re-reads the incumbent's number, which is read from its committed per-seed table. Under R6 it is a distinct arm, declared before this bar existed.
